name: Queensland Regional Electronic Engineering Bursary
summary: Up to $2,500 for regional Queensland school leavers starting electronic engineering at Griffith's Nathan campus.
key: Maximum value is $2,500, paid in instalments.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder.
Completed Year 12 at a Queensland high school outside the South East and Metropolitan regions.
Starting full-time in a listed engineering program at Nathan and choosing an Electronic Engineering major.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
Include a personal statement, an academic referee report and your results.
catches: The page's eligibility wording still refers to 2025 Year 12 and Trimester 1 2026, so check the year with the Scholarships Office.
